name: Toshiba
verdict: Toshiba Corporation has been private since its December 2023 delisting, owned through TBJH by a fund managed by Japan Industrial Partners. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Japanese electronics and energy group, private since December 2023 under a Japan Industrial Partners-led buyout; no state or state fund in the chain → none. Men's Japan national team official partner (JRFU) and sponsor of League One club Toshiba Brave Lupus Tokyo.
